summary: The V4-09 repair candidate for trusted finalizer run 38034294332 is verification-only: changedFiles=0, hasDelta=false, candidate.patch is 0 bytes, and the checkout is byte-identical to the accepted baseline (git worktree at abc7206 == accepted-pristine). Per V4_RELEASE_ENGINEERING.md §7 an identical unchanged re-dispatch is explicitly forbidden ('une répétition identique sans nouvelle preuve doit changer de stratégie'). A coherent no-delta candidate for a repair criterion is retained as WIP and requires the concrete blocker to be fixed, exactly as the prior V4-05 no-delta cycle (RUN_37870302637) was adjudicated. No V4-01..V4-08 regression was introduced (there is no change at all), but V4-09 must-fix work remains. Independent checks reproduced the green baseline: npm run check = 670 passed / 32 suites, privacy:check = 71 passed, cost:check = 29 passed, i18n:check = 9 passed.
